title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Guihulngan District Hospital in Guihulngan, Negros Oriental, From Fifty (50) to Seventy-five (75) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Guihulngan District Hospital in Guihulngan, Negros Oriental, From Fifty (50) to Seventy-five (75) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng số giường bệnh của Guihulngan District Hospital in Guihulngan, Negros Oriental, từ năm mươi lên bảy mươi lăm giường
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของ Guihulngan District Hospital in Guihulngan, Negros Oriental, จากห้าสิบเป็นเจ็ดสิบห้าเตียง
title.id: Undang-Undang menambah kapasitas tempat tidur dari Guihulngan District Hospital in Guihulngan, Negros Oriental, dari lima puluh menjadi tujuh puluh lima tempat tidur

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7276_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Guihulngan District Hospital in Guihulngan, Negros Oriental, is hereby increased from fifty (50) to seventy-five (75) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
